policy: Direct product visuals are promoted only after local capture, redaction review, revision binding, and explicit approval. Planned evidence is never presented as shipped proof.

projects.title: SignKit
projects.captureEnvironment: Packaged or locally run desktop application using synthetic documents and signatures only

assets.requiredState: A synthetic PDF or image has been imported and the local-file boundary is visible before extraction.
assets.redactionRule: Use an invented person, invented document, and non-identifying signature sample. No customer files, recent-file paths, usernames, or local filesystem details.
assets.alt: SignKit desktop application with a synthetic document imported for local signature extraction
assets.caption: The source file is opened inside the desktop workflow; the document remains on the user's device.

assets.requiredState: Multiple detected signature candidates are visible with the active selection and confidence/selection controls shown where they exist.
assets.redactionRule: All signature marks must be synthetic and unrelated to a real person's legal signature.
assets.alt: SignKit showing detected synthetic signature candidates and the selected extraction
assets.caption: The operator reviews detected candidates instead of silently accepting the first visual match.

assets.requiredState: Before/after cleanup is visible with background removal, crop, or contrast controls and no dialog covering the result.
assets.redactionRule: Use the same synthetic source as the extraction shot; do not manufacture an unrealistically perfect result.
assets.alt: SignKit before and after cleanup view for a synthetic handwritten signature image
assets.caption: Cleanup remains operator-visible so the extracted asset can be corrected before reuse.

assets.requiredState: The local signature library or saved-asset surface is visible with at least two synthetic assets and a clear selected state.
assets.redactionRule: No real names, file paths, cloud account details, or authentic signatures.
assets.alt: SignKit local library containing synthetic cleaned signature assets
assets.caption: Cleaned assets can be retained locally for repeated document work without a cloud upload requirement.

assets.requiredState: A synthetic signature is positioned on a synthetic PDF with placement handles or coordinate controls and the final page visible.
assets.redactionRule: The PDF must be invented and clearly non-contractual; never imply certified e-signature or identity verification.
assets.alt: SignKit placing a synthetic signature asset onto a synthetic PDF page
assets.caption: The selected visual asset is positioned in PDF space; this is image placement, not certified electronic signing.

assets.requiredState: A 35–60 second uninterrupted flow: import synthetic source, select extraction, clean it, place it on a PDF, and show the saved result.
assets.redactionRule: Use only synthetic content; crop out desktop notifications, dock badges, account names, and local paths. No narration claim may exceed the visible behavior.
assets.alt: Short recording of the SignKit local signature extraction and PDF placement workflow
assets.caption: A direct product-use recording of the local workflow from source document to PDF placement.

projects.title: MetaExtract
projects.captureEnvironment: Current locally running product with synthetic mixed-format files and deterministic example outputs

assets.requiredState: The input surface shows a small mixed-format synthetic set and the supported/unsupported boundary.
assets.redactionRule: Use generated documents and images only. Remove filesystem paths, account identifiers, tokens, and local hostnames.
assets.alt: MetaExtract file intake surface with a synthetic mixed-format collection
assets.caption: The workspace begins with heterogeneous files rather than assuming one document template.

assets.requiredState: A multi-file extraction run is active or complete with per-file progress, failure, or capability state visible.
assets.redactionRule: Do not hide legitimate failure or unsupported states merely to make the product look complete.
assets.alt: MetaExtract showing per-file extraction progress and visible failure states
assets.caption: Long-running extraction stays inspectable at the file level instead of collapsing into one opaque loading state.

assets.requiredState: A structured result surface shows several metadata families, source file context, and a clear distinction between empty, unsupported, and extracted values.
assets.redactionRule: Use synthetic metadata. Do not claim field coverage or correctness beyond what the visible run demonstrates.
assets.alt: MetaExtract structured results showing multiple metadata families for a synthetic file
assets.caption: Coverage is displayed as structured output, while unsupported and missing values remain distinct from verified extraction.

assets.requiredState: A selected field exposes provenance, raw/normalized value, validation state, or reviewer attention surface.
assets.redactionRule: Use a value whose source and limitations are genuinely represented by the current product.
assets.alt: MetaExtract field review surface showing provenance and validation state
assets.caption: The operator can inspect where a value came from and whether it requires review rather than trusting field count alone.

assets.requiredState: The export or downstream-use surface is visible with selected fields, format, and any access/usage boundary shown.
assets.redactionRule: No real access token, customer identifier, billing data, or private destination may appear.
assets.alt: MetaExtract export surface for selected structured metadata
assets.caption: Reviewed structured output can move into a downstream workflow with the selected scope kept visible.

assets.requiredState: A 45–75 second flow: add synthetic files, run extraction, inspect one provenance record, expose one failure/unsupported state, and export selected output.
assets.redactionRule: Use synthetic inputs and remove all local/server/account identifiers. Preserve real loading and failure behavior.
assets.alt: Short recording of the MetaExtract file intake, extraction, provenance review, and export workflow
assets.caption: A direct operator flow showing extraction coverage, provenance, exceptions, and export as separate product concerns.

projects.title: EchoPanel
projects.captureEnvironment: Current macOS application using a short synthetic meeting script and local transcription

assets.requiredState: The native capture surface and available microphone/system-audio source state are visible before recording.
assets.redactionRule: Hide real device names where identifying, calendar details, menu-bar notifications, and account names.
assets.alt: EchoPanel native capture surface showing available local audio sources
assets.caption: Capture begins as a native local action with source availability and permission state visible.

assets.requiredState: A synthetic recording is active with elapsed time, capture source, and stop/pause behavior visible.
assets.redactionRule: Use an invented meeting title and scripted non-sensitive audio.
assets.alt: EchoPanel recording a synthetic meeting locally with elapsed time visible
assets.caption: The product keeps the recording state explicit so capture failure is visible rather than silently losing a session.

assets.requiredState: The generated transcript and time-aligned navigation are visible after a completed synthetic recording.
assets.redactionRule: Transcript content must be scripted and must not include real conversations or names.
assets.alt: EchoPanel transcript timeline for a synthetic locally recorded conversation
assets.caption: Local transcription is connected to the recording timeline so the user can return to the exact moment.

assets.requiredState: A transcript query returns at least one highlighted match and selected timestamp.
assets.redactionRule: Use a scripted phrase that exists in the captured synthetic audio; do not mock the result independently.
assets.alt: EchoPanel transcript search highlighting a matching phrase and timestamp
assets.caption: Search resolves to a specific recorded moment instead of returning an ungrounded summary alone.

assets.requiredState: The local recording/transcript detail or export surface is visible with storage location represented at a non-identifying level.
assets.redactionRule: No username, complete filesystem path, or real meeting title may be shown.
assets.alt: EchoPanel local recording and transcript export surface
assets.caption: The recording and transcript remain user-controlled local artifacts with an explicit export path.

assets.requiredState: A 40–70 second flow: choose source, record scripted audio, stop, show transcript, search a phrase, jump to its timestamp, and show local export.
assets.redactionRule: Script all audio and remove notifications, user names, device identifiers, and filesystem paths. Do not hide permission or system-audio limitations.
assets.alt: Short recording of the EchoPanel local capture, transcription, search, and timestamp retrieval workflow
assets.caption: A direct product-use recording from native capture to finding a specific moment in the transcript.

projects.title: SentinelTwin
projects.captureEnvironment: Current studio build using a synthetic retail or office scene with no real security layout

assets.requiredState: The editor shows a synthetic scene with walls, obstructions, at least two cameras, and a selected object with inspectable properties.
assets.redactionRule: Never use a real facility plan, camera location, address, access zone, or security policy.
assets.alt: SentinelTwin editor with a synthetic security scene and selected camera object
assets.caption: The scene is an editable operating model rather than a static 3D render.

assets.requiredState: Coverage cones or analysis overlays are visible with a selected camera and at least one explainable coverage metric or boundary.
assets.redactionRule: Use synthetic geometry and label the scene as illustrative wherever the product surface does not already do so.
assets.alt: SentinelTwin deterministic camera coverage analysis in a synthetic scene
assets.caption: Coverage is computed as an inspectable simulation claim before any AI explanation is added.

assets.requiredState: A blind zone and a simulated incident or adversarial path are visible together with the analysis state that produced them.
assets.redactionRule: The path must be synthetic and must not reveal a real exploitable route or live security weakness.
assets.alt: SentinelTwin synthetic blind-zone and incident-path analysis
assets.caption: The platform connects spatial blind zones to an inspectable path scenario instead of presenting coverage as a decorative heatmap.

assets.requiredState: Before/after or baseline/candidate scene states show one camera or obstruction change and the resulting coverage/path difference.
assets.redactionRule: Keep labels and metrics faithful to currently computed behavior; do not type invented improvement percentages into the scene.
assets.alt: SentinelTwin baseline and candidate comparison after a synthetic camera change
assets.caption: A counterfactual scene change can be compared against the baseline so the hardening decision remains reviewable.

assets.requiredState: The evidence/provenance surface for a coverage result or comparison is visible with the originating objects and analysis version where supported.
assets.redactionRule: Use only synthetic object identifiers and scene metadata.
assets.alt: SentinelTwin coverage provenance and evidence surface for a synthetic scene
assets.caption: The operator can trace a coverage claim back to scene objects and analysis state rather than trusting an unexplained conclusion.

assets.requiredState: A 45–75 second flow: select or move a camera/obstruction, run or observe updated coverage, inspect a blind zone/path, compare baseline and candidate, and open provenance.
assets.redactionRule: Use a synthetic scene only. Do not present simulated output as real-world validation or expose actionable security details.
assets.alt: Short recording of the SentinelTwin scene editing, coverage simulation, path analysis, comparison, and provenance workflow
assets.caption: A direct product-use recording showing the deterministic loop from scene edit to evidence-backed comparison.
